answer: The jade counter is kept in sonnet and lotus reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 29 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2692 identities would post 1015 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
